about.label: About Me
about.title: I Build Reliable Digital Experiences
about.primary: I am Rakib, a CSE student and builder who enjoys solving practical problems with clean, maintainable code. My work combines thoughtful UI, performance-aware development, and clear structure so products feel simple to use and easy to improve over time.
about.secondary: Outside classes, I spend time on project-based learning, system thinking, and refining development habits. I care about writing code that is not only functional but also readable, scalable, and team-friendly.
about.quote: I believe strong software is built where clarity, curiosity, and consistency meet.
